spec.hypothesis: Prompt v2（去 offset + 抑制 over-prediction）消除 spurious FP confound 后，recall vs BCS 信号浮现，F1 vs BCS 更强
spec.design: exp1 重跑: count=[1,2,6,12,22,44,64] × 5 random + exp2 重跑: count=6,12 × 25 random + low/high BCS = ~148 batches

pass_criteria.secondary: r(F1, BCS) stronger than v1 results

spec.command: python3 run_experiment.py --mode exp1 --prompt_version v2 --eval_mode text_match && python3 run_experiment.py --mode exp2 --prompt_version v2 --eval_mode text_match
